declared.title: Does a culture of happiness increase rumination over failure?
declared.foundIn: OpenAlex search « culture of happiness increase rumination over failure » (2026-11-22)

population: two studies (an experiment, then a survey); sample sizes and country not given in the abstract

findings.text: Stressing how important happiness is made people ruminate more after a failure

support.sentence: In Study 1, we used an experimental design to show that emphasizing the importance of happiness increased rumination in response to failure.

limits: rumination after a failure, not happiness: another negative experience
the emphasis on happiness is set by the experimenters, not the person's own wish (how it was done: full text not read)
sample sizes not given in the abstract (full text not read); no replication found
